text: My daily routine is quite simple, but I try to stay consistent. I usually wake up at seven o'clock and start my morning with a glass of water and some stretching. After a quick shower and breakfast, I begin work at nine. I work at a computer for most of the day, so I always take a short break every hour. In the afternoon, I go to the gym or run in the park for about forty minutes. In the evening, I cook dinner, watch a series, or read a book. I go to bed before eleven to feel fresh the next day.
